import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		int t = sc.nextInt();
		for(int i=0; i<t; i++) {
			int x = sc.nextInt();
			solve(x);
		}
	}
	
	static void solve(int x) {
		if(x==0) {
			System.out.println("1 1");
			return;
		}
		for(int b=1; b<Math.sqrt(x)+1; b++) {
			if(x%b==0) {
				int c = x/b;
				if(c<b) continue;
				if((b+c)%2==0) {
					int n = (b+c)/2;
					int y = (c-b)/2;
					if(y==0) continue;
					for(int m = n/y; m>0; m--) {
						if(x == n*n-(n/m)*(n/m)) {
							System.out.println(n + " " + m);
							return;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		System.out.println(-1);
	}
}
